comment: Configure contract for httpd. ${PREFIX} is the vendored dependency prefix, ${INSTALL} is where httpd itself is installed (the bundle tree). Every option here is load-bearing: a module that quietly drops out because a --with-* path was not honoured fails the build at the census in scripts/httpd.py, not at first request.

excluded.name: isapi
excluded.reason: Windows-only; modules/arch/win32/config.m4 has no Linux counterpart.

excluded.name: socache_dc
excluded.reason: distcache has been unmaintained since 2005 and is not part of Lounge.

excluded.name: systemd
excluded.reason: Requires libsystemd and a systemd-managed host; a portable bundle must not link it.

excluded.name: privileges
excluded.reason: Solaris-style privilege model needing matching kernel interfaces; not portable.
